fact: Sudan's digital transformation minister told the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference that Sudan had established three specialised bodies within a year, one of them for artificial intelligence, and enacted legislation governing these areas.
The policy centre's analyst Ruaa Taha writes that Sudan has no legal framework regulating personal data given to AI chat systems, and that neither new authority has issued binding rules by mid-2026.
Decrees in November 2025 created the Sudanese Data and AI Authority, a body with a mandate over data and AI, per the article citing the AI Regulation Tracker.
Tasamuh News reports that Sudan's Minister of Justice placed a draft Law Regulating Data and Artificial Intelligence 2026 before the Council of Ministers ahead of approval.
